title: AI Product Manager
description:
AI Product Manager

San Francisco Bay Area (Hybrid, 2-3 days onsite) | Up to $220,000 Base + Bonus

This is an opportunity to join a business that is already delivering AI in production, not just discussing its future potential. You'll take ownership of AI-driven transformation initiatives from discovery through to adoption, helping redesign critical business processes and seeing tangible commercial impact from your work.

The Company

This growing fintech organisation is transforming the way businesses access financial products through AI-powered decision-making. With a strong data foundation and significant investment in AI, they have already deployed production-grade AI solutions across core workflows and are now expanding their AI-first approach across multiple business functions.

Working within a dedicated AI product team, you'll partner closely with domain experts, data scientists, and engineering partners to identify opportunities for meaningful process transformation. The environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and focused on delivering measurable business outcomes.

The Role

As an AI Product Manager, you will:

  • Lead discovery sessions with subject matter experts to understand existing workflows, pain points, edge cases, and operational metrics.
  • Redesign business processes from the ground up using modern AI tools and capabilities.
  • Create detailed product requirements, design briefs, and specifications for engineering partners.
  • Manage third-party engineering teams throughout the build process, ensuring delivery aligns with product vision and requirements.
  • Define evaluation frameworks, quality control processes, and acceptance criteria for AI solutions.
  • Partner with data scientists to develop evaluation rubrics, testing frameworks, and performance benchmarks.
  • Oversee pilot programmes, shadow runs, and go-live activities.
  • Drive stakeholder engagement and end-user adoption across the organisation.
  • Track business impact and continuously refine solutions based on performance data.

Your Skills & Experience

You will have:

  • Strong commercial experience in product management, product strategy, product operations, or a closely related discipline.
  • Experience delivering AI-enabled products or business process transformation initiatives.
  • A proven ability to take ambiguous problems and structure them into clear solutions and deliverables.
  • Experience conducting discovery with stakeholders and translating findings into actionable product requirements.
  • Confidence authoring design briefs, requirements documents, specifications, or process maps that development teams can build from.
  • Working knowledge of AI products, LLMs, AI agents, evaluation frameworks, and quality assurance concepts.
  • Excellent stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust across technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience working with external technology vendors or engineering partners is advantageous.
  • Experience within fintech, payments, lending, or other high-growth technology environments is beneficial but not essential.

What They Offer

  • Exposure to large-scale AI transformation projects with direct business impact.
  • Close collaboration with experienced AI leaders, data scientists, and product specialists.
  • Clear progression opportunities as the AI function continues to expand.
  • The chance to develop deep expertise in AI product management within a commercially successful organisation.

How to Apply

To learn more about this AI Product Manager opportunity, please apply with your CV and we'll be in touch to discuss the role in further detail.
